_description: Single-case reference for the 4-window half-thickness 3D RF sample

_geometry.note_thickness: rf_height halved from 290→145 µm (50% of baseline main 3D RF body height)

note_physics: r0 drifted to far-field vacuum (z=397 µm >> cage top 125 µm). The 3D cage geometry at default voltages/params does not form a strong RF null in the above-cage region with this search range. The far-field minimum is an artefact of Psi→0 at the Neumann boundary, not a real trap. Re-run with explicit r0 in cage window region (z~60–80 µm, x/y offset from rib centers) for a physics-meaningful result.
